caption: One read() call travels from the user, through the syscall and VFS, into the driver's file_operations table, and back out as a byte copy into the caller's buffer. Notice that the driver never writes to the user pointer directly; every byte passes through copy_to_user.

spec.title: read() to a char driver
spec.aria: A downward flowchart of seven boxes: read(fd, buf, 100), sys_read, VFS, file_operations, my_read, copy_to_user, and finally the user buffer.
